title: I Gave 1 Dragon to Stockfish Until I LOSE
summary: Reverse odds on lichess: Fairy-Stockfish (level 8, black) gets only its king plus N Dragons (start 1, +1 each time the narrator wins) against the narrator's full normal army. Dragon = bishop + knight compound. Narrator beats 1, 2 and 3 dragons by pushing/promoting pawns; loses with 4 dragons and again with 5 on a retry.
rules: Dragon (fairy piece): moves and captures like a bishop or a knight (archbishop/princess compound).
Engine: king + N dragons on the back rank (frame shows 4 black dragons on rank 8), no pawns.
Add one dragon after each player win; normal chess rules.
win_condition: Checkmate the engine; run ends at first loss (4 dragons).
